faq_heading: Mountain View Homes for Sale in Maple Ridge: your questions answered

faq.q: What do houses in Silver Valley sell for?
faq.a: 64 houses sold in Silver Valley from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median $1,421,500 after 31 days and 97.8% of the last list price. That covers every house in the area, not only those with a view.

faq.q: Which Maple Ridge neighbourhoods have mountain views?
faq.a: The District points to views in Silver Valley, and mountains show behind Whonnock. The search above shows listings currently flagged with a mountain view.

faq.q: Does a mountain view add to the price?
faq.a: It can, but the closed-sales data has no view field, so the sold table shows each area as a whole. Ask for comparable sales on the same street.

blocks.text: This search shows Maple Ridge homes whose MLS® view field says Mountain View, live from the MLS®, with land and income properties left out. Maple Ridge sits against the mountains on its north side, so a lot of the district has some outlook. The sold prices below help you see where that outlook costs more.
Where Maple Ridge meets the mountains

The District of Maple Ridge names ten neighbourhoods on its website: Albion/Kanaka, Port Hammond, Port Haney, Ruskin, Silver Valley, Thornhill, Town Centre, Webster's Corners, Whonnock and Yennadon. The ones that matter most for mountain views are on the north and east sides.

items.t: Silver Valley lies north of the Alouette River, and the District describes it as having views and trail networks.
Whonnock is a lakeside recreation area on the east side, with mountains rising in the background of the District's own photograph.
Yennadon lists Golden Ears Provincial Park among its attractions.
Thornhill is described by the District as heavily forested and mainly residential, with some farms and nurseries.

blocks.text: What Maple Ridge homes have sold for, by area

These closed sales cover every home in each sub-area, with no filter for view. They are the baseline a view home is priced against. Among the houses, the highest median was $1,421,500 in Silver Valley (64 sold) and the lowest $1,042,500 in Websters Corners (18 sold).

The closed-sales data has no view field, so these medians describe each area as a whole. Use them as the baseline and compare a listing with sales on its own street.
What to check on a Maple Ridge mountain view
Hillside and rural parts of Maple Ridge bring a few practical checks that a photo will not show.

items.t: Confirm the zoning of the parcels in front of the home, since a subdivision can change a view.
On rural and upland lots, ask about water supply, septic and snow, and whether the road is District-maintained.
Look at the view in winter as well as summer, when leaves are down and cloud is lower.
In Whonnock and Thornhill, ask about the Agricultural Land Reserve status of the land beside the home.
